title: Stalum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Stalum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Stalum is a fire-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Defense (A), Luck (B).

sections.title: Is the Stalum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (A), Luck (B). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
